    38	@contextlib.contextmanager
    39	def directory(path, create=False):
    40	    """Abre cada componente sin seguir enlaces, incluso antes de un '..'."""
    41	    path = os.fspath(path)
    42	    if not path or "\0" in path:
    43	        raise BackupError("Ruta de directorio inválida")
    44	    components = path.split(os.sep)
    45	    if not os.path.isabs(path):
    46	        components = os.getcwd().split(os.sep) + components
    47	    fd = os.open(os.sep, DIR_FLAGS)
    48	    try:
    49	        for component in components:
    50	            if component in ("", "."):
    51	                continue
    52	            try:
    53	                next_fd = os.open(component, DIR_FLAGS, dir_fd=fd)
    54	            except FileNotFoundError:
    55	                if not create:
    56	                    raise
    57	                try:
    58	                    os.mkdir(component, 0o700, dir_fd=fd)
    59	                except FileExistsError:
    60	                    pass
    61	                next_fd = os.open(component, DIR_FLAGS, dir_fd=fd)
    62	            os.close(fd)
    63	            fd = next_fd
    64	        yield fd
    65	    finally:
    66	        os.close(fd)

    72	    try:
    73	        for component in components:
    74	            next_fd = os.open(component, DIR_FLAGS, dir_fd=fd)

    82	@contextlib.contextmanager
    83	def regular_file(parent_fd, name):
    84	    fd = os.open(name, READ_FLAGS, dir_fd=parent_fd)
    85	    try:

    93	def overlap(first, second):
    94	    first, second = os.path.abspath(first), os.path.abspath(second)
    95	    common = os.path.commonpath((first, second))
    96	    return common == first or common == second

    99	def source_entries(root_fd):
   100	    entries = []
   101	    pending = [()]
   102	    while pending:
   103	        components = pending.pop()
   104	        with relative_directory(root_fd, components) as fd:
   105	            with os.scandir(fd) as scan:
   106	                names = sorted(entry.name for entry in scan)
   107	            for name in names:
   108	                info = os.stat(name, dir_fd=fd, follow_symlinks=False)
   109	                parts = components + (name,)
   110	                path = "/".join(parts)
   111	                if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
   112	                    entries.append({"path": path, "type": "dir"})
   113	                    pending.append(parts)
   114	                elif stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
   115	                    entries.append({"path": path, "type": "file", "size": info.st_size})
   116	                else:
   117	                    raise BackupError("Enlace o archivo especial en fuente: " + path)
   118	    return sorted(entries, key=lambda entry: entry["path"])

   121	@contextlib.contextmanager
   122	def repository(path, initialize=False):
   123	    with directory(path, create=initialize) as root_fd:
   124	        # El bloqueo vive en el kernel: no requiere metadata persistente.
   125	        # Serializa create (incluida recuperación y cuota) con los lectores.
   126	        fcntl.flock(root_fd, fcntl.LOCK_EX if initialize else fcntl.LOCK_SH)
   127	        with os.scandir(root_fd) as scan:
   128	            names = [entry.name for entry in scan]
   129	        for name in names:
   130	            info = os.stat(name, dir_fd=root_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
   131	            if name not in ("snapshots", "staging") or not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
   132	                raise BackupError("Entrada no permitida en repositorio: " + name)
   133	        if initialize:
   134	            for name in ("snapshots", "staging"):
   135	                try:
   136	                    os.mkdir(name, 0o700, dir_fd=root_fd)
   137	                except FileExistsError:
   138	                    pass
   139	            os.fsync(root_fd)
   140	        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
   141	            dirs = {}
   142	            for name in ("snapshots", "staging"):
   143	                try:
   144	                    dirs[name] = stack.enter_context(relative_directory(root_fd, (name,)))
   145	                except FileNotFoundError:
   146	                    dirs[name] = None
   147	                    continue
   148	                with os.scandir(dirs[name]) as scan:
   149	                    children = [entry.name for entry in scan]
   150	                for child in children:
   151	                    info = os.stat(child, dir_fd=dirs[name], follow_symlinks=False)
   152	                    if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
   153	                        raise BackupError("Enlace o archivo especial en repositorio: " + child)
   154	                    if name == "snapshots":
   155	                        if not child.endswith(EXTENSION):
   156	                            raise BackupError("Nombre de snapshot inválido: " + child)
   157	                        check_id(child[:-len(EXTENSION)])
   158	            yield dirs

   161	def write_all(fd, data):
   162	    remaining = memoryview(data)
   163	    while remaining:
   164	        written = os.write(fd, remaining)
   165	        if written <= 0:
   166	            raise BackupError("No se pudo escribir el archivo completo")
   167	        remaining = remaining[written:]

   170	def read_exact(fd, size):
   171	    chunks = []
   172	    while size:
   173	        chunk = os.read(fd, min(size, CHUNK))
   174	        if not chunk:
   175	            raise BackupError("Snapshot truncado")
   176	        chunks.append(chunk)
   177	        size -= len(chunk)
   178	    return b"".join(chunks)

   181	def repository_bytes(dirs):
   182	    """Suma st_size de TODOS los archivos regulares del formato admitido."""
   183	    total = 0
   184	    for parent_fd in dirs.values():
   185	        if parent_fd is None:
   186	            continue
   187	        for name in os.listdir(parent_fd):
   188	            info = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
   189	            if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
   190	                raise BackupError("Enlace o archivo especial en repositorio: " + name)
   191	            total += info.st_size
   192	    return total

   195	def clean_staging(staging_fd):
   196	    """Bajo bloqueo exclusivo, ningún temporal de create puede estar activo."""
   197	    removed = False
   198	    for name in os.listdir(staging_fd):
   199	        if TEMP_RE.fullmatch(name):
   200	            os.unlink(name, dir_fd=staging_fd)
   201	            removed = True
   202	    if removed:
   203	        os.fsync(staging_fd)

   206	def create(source, repo, snapshot_id, max_bytes=None):
   207	    check_id(snapshot_id)
   208	    if max_bytes is not None and (type(max_bytes) is not int or max_bytes < 0):
   209	        raise BackupError("--max-bytes debe ser un entero no negativo")
   210	    if overlap(source, repo):
   211	        raise BackupError("Fuente y repositorio no pueden solaparse")
   212	    with directory(source) as source_fd:
   213	        entries = source_entries(source_fd)
   214	        manifest = json.dumps(
   215	            {"version": 1, "id": snapshot_id, "entries": entries},
   216	            ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False,
   217	        ).encode("ascii")
   218	        with repository(repo, initialize=True) as dirs:
   219	            snapshots_fd, staging_fd = dirs["snapshots"], dirs["staging"]
   220	            clean_staging(staging_fd)
   221	            final_name = snapshot_id + EXTENSION
   222	            try:
   223	                os.stat(final_name, dir_fd=snapshots_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
   224	            except FileNotFoundError:
   225	                pass
   226	            else:
   227	                raise BackupError("El ID ya existe")
   228	            # Sin compresión: el tamaño final es conocido antes de escribir.
   229	            # El índice, la cabecera y SHA-256 cuentan igual que los datos.
   230	            snapshot_size = (len(MAGIC) + 8 + len(manifest) + 32
   231	                             + sum(entry.get("size", 0) for entry in entries))
   232	            if max_bytes is not None and repository_bytes(dirs) + snapshot_size > max_bytes:
   233	                raise BackupError("El repositorio excedería --max-bytes")
   234	            temporary = ".create-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
   235	            fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
   236	                         0o600, dir_fd=staging_fd)
   237	            try:
   238	                digest = hashlib.sha256()
   239	
   240	                def emit(data):
   241	                    write_all(fd, data)
   242	                    digest.update(data)
   243	
   244	                emit(MAGIC + struct.pack(">Q", len(manifest)))
   245	                emit(manifest)
   246	                for entry in entries:
   247	                    if entry["type"] != "file":
   248	                        continue
   249	                    parts = entry["path"].split("/")
   250	                    with relative_directory(source_fd, parts[:-1]) as parent_fd:
   251	                        with regular_file(parent_fd, parts[-1]) as input_fd:
   252	                            if os.fstat(input_fd).st_size != entry["size"]:
   253	                                raise BackupError("La fuente cambió durante create")
   254	                            remaining = entry["size"]
   255	                            while remaining:
   256	                                chunk = os.read(input_fd, min(remaining, CHUNK))
   257	                                if not chunk:
   258	                                    raise BackupError("La fuente cambió durante create")
   259	                                emit(chunk)
   260	                                remaining -= len(chunk)
   261	                            if os.read(input_fd, 1):
   262	                                raise BackupError("La fuente cambió durante create")
   263	                write_all(fd, digest.digest())
   264	                if os.fstat(fd).st_size != snapshot_size:
   265	                    raise BackupError("Tamaño inesperado del snapshot")
   266	                if max_bytes is not None and repository_bytes(dirs) > max_bytes:
   267	                    raise BackupError("El repositorio excedería --max-bytes")
   268	                os.fsync(fd)
   269	                # link es una publicación atómica que nunca reemplaza otro ID.
   270	                os.link(temporary, final_name, src_dir_fd=staging_fd,
   271	                        dst_dir_fd=snapshots_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
   272	                os.fsync(snapshots_fd)
   273	            finally:
   274	                os.close(fd)
   275	                try:
   276	                    os.unlink(temporary, dir_fd=staging_fd)
   277	                    os.fsync(staging_fd)
   278	                except FileNotFoundError:
   279	                    pass
   280	    return {"id": snapshot_id}

   283	def unique_object(pairs):
   284	    result = {}
   285	    for key, value in pairs:
   286	        if key in result:
   287	            raise BackupError("Clave duplicada en el índice")
   288	        result[key] = value
   289	    return result

   292	def validate_manifest(data, snapshot_id, payload_size):
   293	    try:
   294	        manifest = json.loads(data.decode("ascii"), object_pairs_hook=unique_object)
   295	    except (ValueError, UnicodeError, RecursionError) as error:
   296	        raise BackupError("Índice ilegible") from error
   297	    if not isinstance(manifest, dict) or set(manifest) != {"version", "id", "entries"}:
   298	        raise BackupError("Índice inválido")
   299	    if type(manifest["version"]) is not int or manifest["version"] != 1:
   300	        raise BackupError("Versión de formato no admitida")
   301	    if manifest["id"] != snapshot_id or not isinstance(manifest["entries"], list):
   302	        raise BackupError("Identidad o entradas inválidas")
   303	    known = {}
   304	    previous = ""
   305	    total = 0
   306	    for entry in manifest["entries"]:
   307	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   308	            raise BackupError("Entrada de índice inválida")
   309	        path = entry.get("path")
   310	        kind = entry.get("type")
   311	        if not isinstance(path, str) or not path or "\0" in path or path <= previous:
   312	            raise BackupError("Ruta duplicada, desordenada o inválida")
   313	        parts = path.split("/")
   314	        for part in parts:
   315	            if part in ("", ".", "..") or os.path.isabs(part):
   316	                raise BackupError("Ruta fuera del snapshot")
   317	            if os.sep != "/" and os.sep in part:
   318	                raise BackupError("Separador de ruta inválido")
   319	            try:
   320	                os.fsencode(part)
   321	            except UnicodeError as error:
   322	                raise BackupError("Nombre no representable en este sistema") from error
   323	        parent = "/".join(parts[:-1])
   324	        if parent and known.get(parent) != "dir":
   325	            raise BackupError("Directorio padre ausente o inválido")
   326	        expected = {"path", "type"}
   327	        if kind == "file":
   328	            expected.add("size")
   329	            size = entry.get("size")
   330	            if type(size) is not int or size < 0:
   331	                raise BackupError("Tamaño de archivo inválido")
   332	            total += size
   333	            if total > payload_size:
   334	                raise BackupError("Contenido truncado o tamaños inválidos")
   335	        elif kind != "dir":
   336	            raise BackupError("Tipo de entrada inválido")
   337	        if set(entry) != expected:
   338	            raise BackupError("Campos de entrada inválidos")
   339	        known[path] = kind
   340	        previous = path
   341	    if total != payload_size:
   342	        raise BackupError("Tamaño total del snapshot inválido")
   343	    return manifest["entries"]

   346	def consume_snapshot(fd, snapshot_id, destination_fd=None):
   347	    """Valida todo el archivo; si extrae, el árbol permanece privado hasta el final."""
   348	    os.lseek(fd, 0, os.SEEK_SET)
   349	    file_size = os.fstat(fd).st_size
   350	    if file_size < len(MAGIC) + 8 + 32:
   351	        raise BackupError("Snapshot truncado")
   352	    header = read_exact(fd, len(MAGIC) + 8)
   353	    if header[:len(MAGIC)] != MAGIC:
   354	        raise BackupError("Cabecera de snapshot inválida")
   355	    manifest_size = struct.unpack(">Q", header[len(MAGIC):])[0]
   356	    payload_size = file_size - len(header) - 32 - manifest_size
   357	    if payload_size < 0:
   358	        raise BackupError("Índice truncado")
   359	    manifest = read_exact(fd, manifest_size)
   360	    entries = validate_manifest(manifest, snapshot_id, payload_size)
   361	    digest = hashlib.sha256(header)
   362	    digest.update(manifest)
   363	    for entry in entries:
   364	        parts = entry["path"].split("/")
   365	        output_fd = None
   366	        if destination_fd is not None:
   367	            with relative_directory(destination_fd, parts[:-1]) as parent_fd:
   368	                if entry["type"] == "dir":
   369	                    os.mkdir(parts[-1], 0o700, dir_fd=parent_fd)
   370	                else:
   371	                    output_fd = os.open(
   372	                        parts[-1], os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
   373	                        0o600, dir_fd=parent_fd,
   374	                    )
   375	        if entry["type"] == "dir":
   376	            continue
   377	        try:
   378	            remaining = entry["size"]
   379	            while remaining:
   380	                chunk = os.read(fd, min(remaining, CHUNK))
   381	                if not chunk:
   382	                    raise BackupError("Contenido truncado")
   383	                digest.update(chunk)
   384	                if output_fd is not None:
   385	                    write_all(output_fd, chunk)
   386	                remaining -= len(chunk)
   387	            if output_fd is not None:
   388	                os.fsync(output_fd)
   389	        finally:
   390	            if output_fd is not None:
   391	                os.close(output_fd)
   392	    stored_digest = read_exact(fd, 32)
   393	    if os.read(fd, 1) or not hmac.compare_digest(digest.digest(), stored_digest):
   394	        raise BackupError("Integridad SHA-256 incorrecta")
   395	    if os.fstat(fd).st_size != file_size:
   396	        raise BackupError("El snapshot cambió durante la operación")

   399	@contextlib.contextmanager
   400	def snapshot_file(dirs, snapshot_id):
   401	    if dirs["snapshots"] is None:
   402	        raise BackupError("El ID no existe")
   403	    try:
   404	        with regular_file(dirs["snapshots"], snapshot_id + EXTENSION) as fd:
   405	            yield fd
   406	    except FileNotFoundError as error:
   407	        raise BackupError("El ID no existe") from error

   410	def verify(repo, snapshot_id):
   411	    check_id(snapshot_id)
   412	    with repository(repo) as dirs:
   413	        with snapshot_file(dirs, snapshot_id) as fd:
   414	            consume_snapshot(fd, snapshot_id)
   415	    return {"id": snapshot_id, "valid": True}

   418	def destination_state(parent_fd, name):
   419	    try:
   420	        info = os.stat(name, dir_fd=parent_fd, follow_symlinks=False)
   421	    except FileNotFoundError:
   422	        return None
   423	    if not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
   424	        raise BackupError("El destino debe ser un directorio sin enlaces")
   425	    with relative_directory(parent_fd, (name,)) as fd:
   426	        if os.listdir(fd):
   427	            raise BackupError("El destino preexistente no está vacío")
   428	        actual = os.fstat(fd)
   429	    return actual.st_dev, actual.st_ino

   432	def restore(repo, snapshot_id, dest):
   433	    check_id(snapshot_id)
   434	    if overlap(repo, dest):
   435	        raise BackupError("Destino y repositorio no pueden solaparse")
   436	    # Conserva los componentes originales para rechazar enlaces antes de '..'.
   437	    trimmed = dest.rstrip(os.sep)
   438	    parent, name = os.path.split(trimmed)
   439	    if name in ("", ".", ".."):
   440	        raise BackupError("El destino debe nombrar un directorio hijo")
   441	    with repository(repo) as dirs:
   442	        with snapshot_file(dirs, snapshot_id) as input_fd:
   443	            # Detecta corrupción antes de crear incluso el directorio padre.
   444	            consume_snapshot(input_fd, snapshot_id)
   445	            with directory(parent or ".", create=True) as parent_fd:
   446	                initial = destination_state(parent_fd, name)
   447	                temporary = ".restore-" + uuid.uuid4().hex
   448	                os.mkdir(temporary, 0o700, dir_fd=parent_fd)
   449	                published = False
   450	                try:
   451	                    with relative_directory(parent_fd, (temporary,)) as stage_fd:
   452	                        consume_snapshot(input_fd, snapshot_id, stage_fd)
   453	                        os.fsync(stage_fd)
   454	                    if destination_state(parent_fd, name) != initial:
   455	                        raise BackupError("El destino cambió durante restore")
   456	                    os.rename(temporary, name, src_dir_fd=parent_fd, dst_dir_fd=parent_fd)
   457	                    published = True
   458	                    os.fsync(parent_fd)
   459	                finally:
   460	                    if not published:
   461	                        shutil.rmtree(temporary, dir_fd=parent_fd)
   462	    return {"id": snapshot_id}
   463	
   464	
   465	def list_snapshots(repo):
   466	    # Un repositorio inexistente o un directorio nuevo vacío contiene cero IDs.
   467	    try:
   468	        with directory(repo):
   469	            pass
   470	    except FileNotFoundError:
   471	        return {"snapshots": []}
   472	    snapshots = []
   473	    with repository(repo) as dirs:
   474	        if dirs["snapshots"] is not None:
   475	            for name in sorted(os.listdir(dirs["snapshots"])):
   476	                snapshot_id = name[:-len(EXTENSION)]
   477	                with regular_file(dirs["snapshots"], name) as fd:
   478	                    try:
   479	                        consume_snapshot(fd, snapshot_id)
   480	                    except BackupError:
   481	                        # Solo se enumeran snapshots íntegros y completos.
   482	                        continue
   483	                snapshots.append(snapshot_id)
   484	    return {"snapshots": sorted(snapshots)}
   485	
   486	
   487	def main():
   488	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, allow_abbrev=False)
   489	    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
   490	    for command in ("create", "verify", "restore", "list"):
   491	        subparser = commands.add_parser(command, allow_abbrev=False)
   492	        subparser.add_argument("--repo", required=True)
   493	        if command != "list":
   494	            subparser.add_argument("--id", required=True)
   495	        if command == "create":
   496	            subparser.add_argument("--source", required=True)
   497	            subparser.add_argument("--max-bytes", type=int, default=None, metavar="N",
   498	                                   help="Máxima suma de st_size del repo, incluida metadata")
   499	        if command == "restore":
   500	            subparser.add_argument("--dest", required=True)
   501	    args = parser.parse_args()
   502	    try:
   503	        if args.command == "create":
   504	            result = create(args.source, args.repo, args.id, args.max_bytes)
   505	        elif args.command == "verify":
   506	            result = verify(args.repo, args.id)
   507	        elif args.command == "restore":
   508	            result = restore(args.repo, args.id, args.dest)
   509	        else:
   510	            result = list_snapshots(args.repo)
   511	        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":")))
   512	        return 0
   513	    except (BackupError, OSError, ValueError, OverflowError, RecursionError) as error:
   514	        print(json.dumps({"error": str(error)}, ensure_ascii=True), file=sys.stderr)
   515	        return 1
   516	
   517	
   518	if __name__ == "__main__":
   519	    sys.exit(main())

item.text: La revisión del código muestra un riesgo de mutación de la fuente: la comprobación de solapamiento normaliza `..`, pero la creación del repositorio recorre la ruta original y puede crear directorios dentro de la fuente antes de salir de ella. También encontré una restricción no prevista para destinos terminados en `.`. Los ejemplos públicos reportan restauraciones exactas y rechazo por cuota; no constituyen una validación independiente.
